name: ContextFetch
description: Web search and page contents for AI agents, returned as Markdown pruned to the passages relevant to the query. No key is needed for 25 requests per IP per UTC day; `POST /v1/keys/free` gives a free key with 2,500 credits; packs are one-time payments (https://contextfetch.dev/pricing). The Exa SDKs work with base URL `https://api.contextfetch.dev` and the Tavily SDKs with `https://api.contextfetch.dev/tavily`. Full reference with response examples: https://contextfetch.dev/llms-full.txt
